usageNotes: Use this to inspect the individual CIDR entries belonging to a specific SDN prefix list, which is useful for auditing route filters or verifying BGP/EVPN policy before pushing changes. Requires the SDN.Audit privilege on the prefix list's SDN path (/sdn/prefix-lists/{id}). The prefix list must already exist; use get_cluster_sdn_prefix_lists to enumerate valid IDs first.

examples.summary: List all entries in a prefix list named 'trusted-ranges'

tips: After a prefix list is modified, run this endpoint to confirm the expected entries are present before applying or reloading SDN.
An empty array response is valid and simply means the prefix list exists but has no entries configured yet.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), making this safe to call from automation scripts with a read-only SDN.Audit token.
